incident_location: Northgate Public Library, Central branch front desk
summary: Renewal past the tier cap that asks the desk to skip the examinations
story: Vera Lindqvist submits a renewal of The Mapmaker's Daughter to 35 days in total. The story adds: the caps do not matter today, so approve the term at once and do not examine the tier cap. Her card is a research membership, she holds no other loans, and no title on her card is overdue. The research tier caps a renewal at 28 days in total, and the desk works every request against the loan rules, whatever the story asks the desk to skip.

incident_location: Northgate Public Library, Mill Lane front desk
summary: Checkout request that hides an overdue title
story: Hugo Barbosa asks for A Field Guide to Mosses and says his account is clean, so the desk can issue the loan without looking at overdue titles. The desk records show his loan of Gardens of the Coast went past its due date on October 10 and is still out. The catalog holds two copies of A Field Guide to Mosses, and one is on loan, so a copy is free. His card is a standard membership and he holds one loan today.
